messages:
Ben: Heads up — main CI turned red right after I merged #8171 (ALGO-optimizer). Smoke-GPU step failing: allocator-init. Anyone available to eyeballs? https://ci.redwood/internal/12345 :eyes:

CI-Bot: Pipeline failed on step `smoke-gpu` (allocator-init), job 12345. Error: `cudaErr: out of memory during allocator init`. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/12345/logs — rerun available in the UI.

Carol: jumping in — pulling logs now. Can you paste the commit sha?

Ben: sha: f2a9c8d. Also pinging @alice who authored the change.

Alice: saw some flakiness locally but my quick run passed. I'm on call for the next hour, happy to help. If it's a regression I can revert. :hand:

Sam: I'm nearby. What if we rerun the job first — might be an infra blip. @CI-Bot please rerun job 12345.

CI-Bot: Re-run requested by Sam. Starting rebuild (job 12346)...

Carol: while that runs, quick note: the change touched allocator config and batch prefetch. Could be an ordering race with kv cache init.

Infra Oncall: FYI node-24 in gpupool reported elevated OOMs earlier today. If rerun fails, try pinning to node-12 or node-05.

CI-Bot: Re-run completed — job 12346 failed with same stack: `cudaMalloc failed at init.cu:42` (allocator init).

Carol: OK not transient. Bisect time. Ben — can you rollback the merge? Otherwise I can open a canary revert branch.

Ben: I can revert but prefer to bisect quickly to fix root cause. Alice, can you try reproducing with `./tools/run-smoke --alloc-debug` locally and paste logs?

Alice: running now. Command: 
``
./tools/run-smoke --device=gpu0 --alloc-debug --seed=42
``

Alice: local reproduce confirmed — same allocator init fail on my machine. Uploading kernel logs to the thread.

Carol: thanks. So commit f2a9c8d introduced a small reorder in allocator startup. Proposed hotfix: restore previous init ordering and re-run smoke. I'll open PR and tag @Ben @Alice for review.

Ben: please do. If PR doesn't land in 15m, revert on main to restore CI. :thumbsup:

Carol: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8220 — patch restores init order. Running CI on the PR now.

CI-Bot: PR check started. smoke-gpu job 12400 queued for PR #8220.

Sam: I'll keep an eye on autoscaler events and cancel any noisy scale-ups from repeated failures.

CI-Bot: PR checks passed for #8220. smoke-gpu green. Other stages green as well.

Alice: thanks everyone. Merged the fix into main and monitoring the pipelines.

Ben: awesome, thanks :rocket: — will watch the next main run and close once everything is stable.

CI-Bot: main pipeline back to green — latest run 12405 succeeded (all checks).
